  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  APRIL 18, 2020

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 3:30 p.m., on
  Saturday, April 18, 2020, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 at
  https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/pqpsykba

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Greg Morena
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Also Present:  Assistant City Manager Katie Lichtig
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 3:30 p.m., with all
  members present.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 3:33 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 4:43 p.m., with all members present, to
  report the following:

  1.A.  Public Employee, Government Code Section 54957(b):
  City Manager – Separation Offer

  The Assistant City Attorney reported that Rick Cole has offered to step
  aside from his position as City Manager in order to facilitate the
  restructuring that must take place in the city. Outside Counsel Laura Kalty,
  has negotiated a separation agreement. The matter is before the Council for
  a vote on whether to accept Mr. Coles offer by mutual agreement, subject
  to approval of the negotiated separation agreement, and relieve Mr. Cole
  from any duties as City Manager, and place him on paid administrative
  leave, effective as of today, April 18, 2020.

  1  April 18, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: D50A5F3D-BF73-4EE5-A45C-9E7221576983

  Motion by Councilmember Jara, seconded by Councilmember Davis, to
  accept Rick Coles resignation, with a separation agreement and paid
  administrative leave by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Jara, Winterer, Davis, Himmelrich, Morena,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  1.B.  Public Employee, Government Code Section 54957(b):
  Interim City Manager – Appointment

  The Mayor reported that the City Council selected Lane Dilg, to serve as
  the Interim City Manager.

  Motion by Councilmember Winterer, seconded by Councilmember Davis,
  to appoint Lane Dilg as the Interim City Manager by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Morena, Himmelrich, Davis, Winterer, Jara,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  1.C. Conference with Labor Negotiator: Government Code Section
  54957.6. Agency Designated Representatives: Laura Kalty, Outside
  Counsel, Liebert Cassidy Whitmore. Unrepresented Employee:
  Interim City Manager

  The Assistant City Attorney reported that the Council authorized outside
  Council Laura Kalty to negotiate an employment agreement with Interim
  City Manager Dilg.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 4:49 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Kevin McKeown
  City Clerk  Mayor

  2  April 18, 2020
